tracks.title: Legacy IP reimplementation
tracks.description: Reimplement an existing, publicly accessible legacy IP from its documented behavior and interface; measure functional fidelity, protocol correctness, maintainability and implementation quality.

tracks.title: IP rewrite, feature addition and optimization
tracks.description: Modify an existing IP to add or improve functionality, optimize architecture or implementation, and preserve all declared compatibility requirements.

tracks.title: IP porting and technology adaptation
tracks.description: Port an existing IP to a new interface, target technology or implementation environment while preserving its behavioral contract and measuring portability and PPA.

tasks.title: Fixed-point CORDIC rotation

evaluation.ppa: Nangate45 Liberty mapping and ideal-clock OpenSTA, pre-layout

limitations: The sampled post-selection numerical audit is not a hidden holdout or formal proof.
Liberty area and ideal-clock OpenSTA are pre-layout estimates, not physical signoff.

tasks.title: Signed 16x16 integer multiplier

evaluation.functional: Verilator plus independent Python integer oracle
evaluation.mutation: public source-level mutations rejected by independent functional oracle

limitations: No protocol formal, equivalence, mutation, mapped PPA or post-selection audit; not comparable to fully runnable CORDIC.
